Unless stated otherwise, every item can only be purchased once by each model. Any model with access to the Armory can buy as many items as it wants.
Everytime a model dies within 6" of this model it gains one temporary wound. The wound is lost at the end of the battle round. Can only have one temporary wound at a time.
One melee weapon of the model gains cumulative Extra Attack(4). Unique. Can't be combined with other blades.
The model gains the "Deflect" and "Parry" abilities. Unique.
One melee weapon of the model gains Shield breaker(-2). Unique. Can't be combined with other blades.
One melee weapon of the model gains +1 Strength and Decimate. Unique. Can't be combined with other blades.
To wound rolls against the bearer suffer a -1 penalty. (Unique)
The model gains the "Bodyguard" and "Command squad" abilities.
